nodes.summary: If $P$ is a partition of a finite set $s$ and $B$ is a block of $P$, then $|B| \le |s|$.
nodes.title: Blocks are no larger than the ground set

nodes.summary: Let $P$ be a partition of a finite set $s$ that is not the coarsest partition $\top$ of $s$ (the one whose only block is $s$ when $s$ is nonempty). Then every block $B$ of $P$ satisfies $|B| < |s|$.
nodes.title: Blocks of a partition other than the coarsest are smaller than the ground set

nodes.summary: Pulling back along an equivalence preserves the number of blocks.
nodes.title: Pull-back along an equivalence preserves the number of blocks

nodes.summary: A partition $P$ of a finite set $s$ has at least one block, that is, its number of blocks is positive, if and only if $s$ is nonempty.
nodes.title: A partition has a block exactly when its ground set is nonempty

nodes.summary: Pulling back along an equivalence preserves every product over the block sizes.
nodes.title: Pull-back along an equivalence preserves block-size products

nodes.summary: Let $P$ be a partition of a finite set $s$, let $R$ and $S$ be commutative monoids, let $f : \mathbb{N} \to R$, and let $g : R \to S$ be a monoid homomorphism. Then $g\bigl(\prod_{B \in P} f(|B|)\bigr) = \prod_{B \in P} g(f(|B|))$, where both products run over the blocks $B$ of $P$.
nodes.title: Monoid homomorphisms preserve block-size products

nodes.summary: For a partition $P$ of a finite set $s$, a commutative monoid $R$ and a function $f : \mathbb{N} \to R$, the block-size product of $f$ over $P$ is $\prod_{B \in P} f(|B|)$, the product over the blocks $B$ of $P$ of $f$ applied to the cardinality of $B$.
nodes.title: Product over block sizes

nodes.summary: Pulling back along a composite is pulling back twice.
nodes.title: Pulling back a partition along a composite

nodes.summary: Pulling back along the identity does nothing.
nodes.title: Pulling back a partition along the identity

nodes.summary: Pulling back along `e` and then along `e.symm` gives back the partition.
nodes.title: Pulling back along an equivalence and its inverse

nodes.summary: The pull-back of a partition `P` of the finite type `β` along a map `f : α → β`: the blocks are the nonempty preimages `f ⁻¹' B` of the blocks `B` of `P`.
nodes.title: Pull-back of a finite partition along a map

nodes.summary: A partition $P$ of a finite set $s$ is the finest partition $\bot$ of $s$, whose blocks are the singletons $\{a\}$ for $a \in s$, if and only if the number of blocks of $P$ equals $|s|$.
nodes.title: Recognizing the partition into singletons by its number of blocks

nodes.summary: If $P$ is a partition of a nonempty finite set $s$, then $P$ is the coarsest partition $\top$ of $s$, whose only block is $s$, if and only if $P$ has exactly one block.
nodes.title: Recognizing the one-block partition

nodes.summary: The blocks of `P.comap f` are the nonempty preimages of the blocks of `P`.
nodes.title: Blocks of a pulled-back partition

nodes.summary: Every block $B$ of a partition of a finite set $s$ satisfies $|B| \ge 1$.
nodes.title: Blocks are nonempty

nodes.summary: Along an equivalence `e`, the blocks of `P.comap e` are the images of the blocks of `P` under `e.symm`.
nodes.title: Blocks of a partition pulled back along an equivalence

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
